hooks.name: Log Kiro usage after each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, append a short entry to docs/kiro-usage-log.md: raw material for the write-up and blog.

action.prompt: A spec task has just finished. Append a dated entry to docs/kiro-usage-log.md (do not rewrite earlier entries). Say, in plain short sentences: which task it was; which Kiro features were used (spec, steering, hooks, MCP, custom agents, the power); what was built; what was proved or tested, with real numbers from the last test run; and anything not yet checked by a person. Never write that a game is fully accessible.
